title: Shower Squeegee With Smooth Handle, 20-Inch, Wall Mount Solid Brass With Mounting Hook - Traditional Style, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep shower doors, tile, and mirrors spot-free after every rinse with a wall-mounted shower squeegee that stores neatly on its included hook. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, this solid brass set is built for daily bathroom use.

  • Wipe away moisture fast to reduce water spotting on glass, tile, and mirrors
  • Save space with a wall mount mounting hook that keeps the squeegee within reach
  • Choose a look that fits traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures
  • Replace the blade easily when it’s time to refresh performance
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives

What’s included

  • Squeegee, blade, mounting hook, and all installation hardware

Specs

  • Size: 20 Inch
  • Product dimensions (LxHxW): 10 x 15 x 10 in
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with coordinating pieces in matching finishes.

variants.title: Mediterranean Blue Shower Squeegee With Smooth Handle, 20-Inch, Wall Mount Solid Brass With Mounting Hook - Traditional Style, Allied Brass
variants.body_html:
Keep shower doors, tile, and mirrors spot-free after every rinse with a wall-mounted shower squeegee that stores neatly on its included hook in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, this solid brass set is built for daily bathroom use.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Choose a look that fits traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures
  • Replace the blade easily when it’s time to refresh performance
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives

What’s included

  • Squeegee, blade, mounting hook, and all installation hardware

Specs

  • Size: 20 Inch
  • Product dimensions (LxHxW): 10 x 15 x 10 in
  • Mounting: Wall mount
  • Material: Brass (solid brass construction)
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Complete your bathroom with coordinating pieces in matching finishes.
